'Looksmaxxing' influencer Clavicular charged with rape, drugging woman ALBAWABA - Controversial "looksmaxxing" influencer and streamer Clavicular, whose legal name is Braden Peters, was recently charged with rape and drugging a woman for sex, while also providing alcohol to a minor in Massachusetts, according to The Bulwark.The right-wing influencer is best known for being part of the "looksmaxxing" community, an internet subculture aimed at maximizing an individual's physical attractiveness as a form of self-improvement.The charges were filed at a courthouse on Sept. 8, citing an incident that occurred on May 23, 2025. The alleged victim, 18-year-old content creator Aleksandra Vasilevna Mendoza (also known as Alorah Ziva), accused Clavicular of injecting her with Aqualyx without her consent during a livestream in 2025, as previously reported by CBS News.Aqualyx is a fat-dissolving substance not approved by the FDA.
